articles.title: Treasury yields fall as investors anticipate FOMC minutes
articles.description: U.S. Treasury yields were broadly lower on Tuesday morning after reaching fresh highs the previous day.

articles.title: Why bitcoin is down 'just' 32% a year after its record high of $126,000
articles.description: This shallower decline isn’t limited to the one-year anniversary. The bear market itself has been milder with past downturns seeing prices plummet 77% to 85%.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $90M as BTC sits 32% below year-old ATH
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs reversed two days of inflows as Bitcoin slipped below $86,000, trading roughly 32% below its October 2025 all-time high.

articles.title: EEZ tests atomic L1-to-L2 transaction in push to unify Ethereum
articles.description: An EEZ contributor shared a 0.001 ETH cross-chain test as the project develops a framework to connect Ethereum mainnet and its rollups.

articles.title: Trump allows cheaper, dyed diesel on highways to blunt historic fuel-cost spike ahead of midterms
articles.description: The U.S. national average price of diesel topped $6 a gallon in September for the first time ever, as fuel supply disruptions pushed up transportation costs in the country.

articles.title: House China committee chair urges Fed to review Hong Kong’s access to dollar lifeline
articles.description: Rep. John Moolenaar wants the Fed to rethink Hong Kong’s access to a dollar-liquidity facility as China promotes the renminbi as a global currency.

articles.title: How quant funds beat the market by being 'early, contrarian and right'
articles.description: Quantitative hedge funds have captured big trends in bonds and oil to outperform the stock market this year.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Better Markets says CFTC is ‘wrong agency’ to regulate retail crypto
articles.description: Better Markets said the CFTC’s proposed framework to bring certain cryptocurrency transactions and exchanges under its oversight will leave investors less protected than under the SEC.

articles.title: U.S. scraps proposed $10,000 reporting rule for for crypto sent to private wallets
articles.description: FinCEN withdrew two proposals that had hung over self-custody and crypto mixers for years without ever taking effect.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test gets last-minute fix before major capacity jump
articles.description: One of Ethereum’s main validator clients updated its software hours before a Sepolia test that will raise the amount of work each block can hold to 200 million gas.

articles.title: Bitcoin keeps getting rejected at $87,000 as stocks hover near records
articles.description: BTC fell back to about $85,600 after sellers turned it away from $87,000 for the third time since Sept. 23, while Nasdaq closed at a record and Treasury yields kept climbing.

articles.title: Solana Foundation unveils a program to settle institutional trades in seconds. JPMorgan gave input
articles.description: Solana Foundation launched an open-source program that lets institutions settle trades in seconds, not days. JPMorgan provided key inputs.

articles.title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%
articles.description: The World Bank now expects the region to grow 4.5% this year, but flagged that trade growth outside AI-related goods has been "weak or negative."

articles.title: Rain seeks US trust bank charter days after OCC sued over crypto charters
articles.description: Rain joins a growing queue of crypto firms seeking federal trust charters, while community banks have just asked a court to overturn the OCC rules underpinning them.

articles.title: OKX eyes emerging markets with yield-offering stablecoin savings and payments app
articles.description: OKX Money lets users hold, send and spend dollar-backed stablecoins, with qualifying USDG balances earning up to 10% APY.

articles.title: Little room for ‘giving and taking’: India’s finance minister confirms trade impasse with the U.S.
articles.description: In the latest sign of growing skepticism around the closure of the trade deal between New Delhi and Washington, an Indian minister said there is little room for ‘giving and taking.’

articles.title: Pentagon says Trump approves Army firing squad execution of Fort Hood killer Nidal Hasan
articles.description: Former Army Maj. Nidal Hassan was sentenced to death after a court-martial that convicted him of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at an Army base in Texas.

articles.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
articles.description: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

articles.title: Trump says MAGA Inc. PAC will pay for controversial TV ads that government funded
articles.description: The New York Times reported "Trump personally instructed his budget director to use taxpayer money for TV ads praising him and his presidency."
